paper_reference: Liu et al., 'DeepCrack: A Deep Hierarchical Feature Learning Architecture for Crack Segmentation', Neurocomputing, 2019
license_and_usage: Restricted to non-commercial research and educational purposes

validation.status: No official validation split in original source (requires partitioning from train)

leakage_findings: 10 image filename stems ('11289-1' to '11289-10') appear in both train and test. Visual hash verification confirms they are distinct sub-crops, but share the same underlying asset sequence. Group-aware splitting recommended for leakage prevention.

yolo_compatibility.detection: Compatible via minimum bounding rectangle extraction around mask contours.
yolo_compatibility.segmentation: Directly compatible with YOLO11-Seg via OpenCV polygon contour approximation.
